description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to generate economy-wide effects in terms of job creation and value addition and have positive environmental effects by improving soil fertility. At a market level, IFC expects its financing to contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of the dairy farming sector in Chile by further strengthening and showcasing the New Zealand-style pasture grazing system with superior productivity and cost competitiveness.

Manuka SpA (Manuka or the Company) is a Chilean milk producer located in southern regions of Los Lagos and Los Rios, operating a pasture-based dairy production model. Manuka is a founding member of Campos Australes, Chiles second-largest dairy cooperative, which has grown to represent approximately 80 predominantly small-scale farmers. IFCs proposed investment will support Manukas investment program, including the rearing of youngstock and investments in soil fertility and pasture productivity, and limited refinancing (the Project).
